policy: Every AnalysisResult, NormalizedReaction, CaseOverview and SignalRow field has one validation owner. Publication comparison is limited to cohort-sensitive cases, ROR/PRR direction, signal direction and rank/drift relationships. Exact confidence intervals, IC/EBGM implementations, overview values and non-statistical outputs remain deterministic contracts unless a paper-matched raw quarterly snapshot and identical estimator are available.

groups.limitation: Selected papers provide overview context, but exact values depend on paper-specific quarterly files, deduplication and inclusion criteria; the project model is validated with independently expected report-level frozen fixtures.
None of the selected publications reports a reproducible top-concomitant table; exact C-role binding is validated on the frozen report-level backend.
Current openFDA aggregates are compared with published cases, ROR/PRR direction, signal direction and within-drug ROR rank/drift. They are not represented as exact paper reproduction.

Published confidence intervals, BCPNN and GPS/EBGM values are not exact numerical oracles unless the raw cohort and estimator/prior are identical; known-answer and fitted-prior tests own these fields.
Published FAERS tables cannot be a numerical oracle for label NLP, EviMed retrieval or LLM narrative; the deterministic statistics remain independent of these degradable layers.

Papers provide methodological context for roles, routes and date windows, but cannot validate this run's query URLs, snapshot identity/hash, generated time or runtime provenance; all fields in this group are owned by deterministic contract tests.
